About the role
As Senior Principal Reliability Engineer GaN/SiC (m/f/d), you will play a crucial role in ensuring the reliability and durability of our GaN and SiC products, by supporting customers with reliability and lifetime predictions, with product reliability competence, developing reliability testing, analyzing failure mechanisms, optimizing designs and processes, and providing valuable insights to enhance the overall performance and reliability of our technologies.

This is your new job

- Develop and manage the reliability test plan for GaN/SiC products and calculate extrapolated lifetime for given mission profiles
- Enable early identification and characterization of failure mechanisms and link to performance and lifetime limitations through simulation and predictive analytics
- Determining the effect of the different stress factors on the lifetime and plot the failure distribution for each stressor as result of test-to-fail
- Derive lifetime models and drifts prediction for main parameters. Identify fail-in-time estimation (FIT, ppm)
- Setup a lifetime estimation model fitting customers application profile, derive pass/fail criteria
- Enable early identification and characterization of failure mechanisms and link to performance and lifetime limitations through simulation and predictive analytics
- Manage the concept of reliability tests with external partners
- Drive reliability tests and analyze reliability test results data to extract acceleration parameters
- Collaborate closely with design, quality, product engineering, packaging, and process technology teams to drive Design for Reliability (DfR) into product development
- Identify and address reliability gaps and drive reliability improvements activities
- Collaborate with the R&D and Quality teams to develop/improve tests and analysis methods of GaN and SiC products
- Monitor failure analysis investigation to understand the main wear-out failure mechanisms
- Establish and lead external partnerships with universities, research consortia, and industry working groups on Power Semiconductor reliability standards and methods for wide band gap materials

This is you:

- Master's Degree or equivalent in Experimental Physics, Electronics Engineering, or a similar discipline, PhD preferred
- Strong knowledge of GaN and SiC semiconductor physics, or at least of one of the two technologies and the ability to learn the other
- Minimum 7 years of experience of power semiconductor devices, ideally wide band gap and GaN HEMTs
- Understanding of mechanical, electrical and thermal failure modes in semiconductor products, and failure analysis techniques
- Knowledge of international quality standards such as JEDEC, AEC-Q101, AQG 324, reliability test to fail methods, and reliability test equipment
- Experience working within GaN and/or SiC reliability in an industrial environment is highly advantageous,
- Strong knowledge of wafer fab processes. Knowledge of assembly process preferred
- Strong data analysis skills (JMP, MATLAB, etc.) with clear written and verbal communication skills
- High quality mindset, towards product and customers
- Fluent spoken and written English skills
- Strong know how in statistical data analysis
- Excellent communication and presentation skills
- Ability to work under pressure

jobs.occupation: PhD Student (f/m/d) (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description:
The research group „Mitochondrial Protein biogenesis“ headed by Prof. Dr. Peter Rehling at the Institute of Cellular Biochemistry is inviting applications for a

PhD Student (f/m/d)

- New approaches to mitochondrial gene expression -

About us

Our group is located at the University Medical Center Göttingen (UMG) and is associated to the Max-Planck-Institute for Multidisciplinary Sciences in Göttingen, Germany. Our research is aimed at understanding the mechanisms by which mitochondria build and shape their proteome. To study these systems, we combine cell biology with biochemical and biophysical approaches. For recent examples of our work, see PMID: 40403134, 40155273, 34672953, 39134548, 38199007 and 34588454.

We offer access to state-of-the art instrumentation and technologies to address the molecular principles that drive protein transport. Göttingen is a vibrant, international student town located in the center of Germany and, in addition to its university, is home to a number of renowned research institutes, which together form the Göttingen Research Campus.

Position details

The position is fixed term (3 years) and the salary will be in accordance to the German Public Sector Collective Agreement (TV-L). The earliest starting date is October 1st 2026. The UMG is committed to increasing the number of individuals with disabilities in its workforce and therefore encourages applications from such qualified individuals. We further strive for gender and diversity equality. We welcome applications from all backgrounds.

How to apply

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the positions are filled. To apply, please submit a single PDF containing a short statement of motivation and previous experience, a CV, and the names and contacts of at least two references via the system. 

For more information, visit our lab website: https://biochemie.uni-goettingen.de/index.php/mitochondrial-protein-biogenesis-v-2/

Yours tasks

- Combine cutting-edge yeast genetics, protein- and RNA biochemistry as well as cellular methods to develop new strategies for DNA transport into mitochondria
- Drive your own research project in a collaborative team with close mentoring and supervision
- Present & communicate research results at national and international scientific meetings
- Gain experience in mentoring and teaching of students

Your qualifications

- Applicants should hold a M.Sc. or equivalent degree in the life sciences or a related discipline
- Previous experience in yeast biology, protein biochemistry is advantageous, but not required
- Fluent English language skills (written and spoken) are required

We offer

- High-impact research field with biomedical relevance
- Small, international and diverse research group with a strong team spirit and an open-minded, collaborative and respectful working atmosphere
- Access to state-of-the-art infrastructure & hands-on training in latest methods in molecular biology and biochemistry
- Structured cross-institutional graduate program that offers numerous mentoring and career support opportunities

jobs.occupation: Client Relationship Lead (Account-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Job Title: Client Relationship Lead

International SOS is the world’s leading medical and security services company with over 12,000 employees working in 1,000 locations in 90 countries. International SOS Government Services administers the TRICARE Overseas Program providing high-quality, accessible health care services for U.S. Military service members, family members, retirees, and other eligible beneficiaries overseas.

About the role

We’re seeking a dynamic and experienced professional to join our senior management team as a Client Relationship Lead. In this pivotal role, you will serve as the primary subject matter expert for our clients, fostering strong relationships with key stakeholders to ensure the seamless delivery of services and exceptional satisfaction with the TRICARE Overseas Program (TOP).

This role is a high-impact position and requires someone with exceptional networking abilities to influence and drive positive outcomes.

Location:

Remote working- with frequent travel across Germany

Why This Role is Exceptional:

- **Strategic Influence:** Shape the success of the TRICARE Overseas Program by building and nurturing high-level relationships with military and civilian partners.
- **Global Impact:** Work closely with Military Treatment Facilities, Bases, and Remote TOP Dedicated Network Sites worldwide to ensure the highest quality of service.
- **Flexibility and Travel:** Choose between a home-based or office-based position with the opportunity for international travel, allowing you to directly engage with stakeholders and make a difference on a global scale.

If you are a proactive, relationship-driven professional with a passion for healthcare and the military community, we’d love to hear from you!

Key responsibilities

- Lead, coordinate and drive the overall contractual KPI deliverables for Military Treatment Facilities (MTF), engagement, coordination of collaboration across all client and TOP stakeholders, securing access to care, contractual provider availability and network services, medical records collections, claims handling, beneficiary services.
- Oversight and support in the coordination of execution of all tasks that impact the MTF through in-country personnel (clinical/non-clinical) in the Area of Responsibility (AOR).
- Maintain and strengthen relationships with stakeholders by means of identifying and communicating client needs in a timely manner

jobs.occupation: Working student (d/f/m) for Industrial Architecture (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support the Industrial Architecture Team, Airbus Operations is looking for a

Working student (d/f/m) for Industrial Architecture

You are a full time student, looking for a working student position and want to get to know the work of an Industrial Architect?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in department designation as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

At Airbus, Industrial Architecture is driving the next evolution of flight. We are looking for a collaborative, forward-thinking student to join us in shaping the industrial system for our next-generation single-aisle aircraft. If you are passionate about innovation, teamwork, and making a real-world impact, we would love to welcome you to our team.

- Location: Hamburg
- Start: 01.11.2026
- Duration:  12 months

You will receive a collectively agreed salary of at least €18.53 per hour, depending on the job. There are also special payments such as vacation pay.

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location: Hamburg Finkenwerder

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Are you wondering how you actually get from university to Airbus? Your working student position is at the Finkenwerder plant and you can take the ferry from Teufelsbrück to the Airbus ferry terminal and back to the university in the morning and at noon. Alternatively, you can take the ferry to Finkenwerder and then ride your bike for about another 15 minutes to the main entrance.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your Mission

You will play a vital role in supporting our team and management as we design the most efficient, sustainable, and innovative industrial system for the next Airbus aircraft.

How You Will Make an Impact:

- Coordinate & Align: Help keep our international teams connected and on track by co-creating and managing progress updates across time, cost, and quality.
- Encourage Fresh Perspectives: Bring your unique curiosity to the table. We value open dialogue and encourage you to constructively question the "status quo" to help us discover creative, innovative paths forward.
- Foster Connection: Support the organization and execution of collaborative events that bring our management and transnational teams together.

The Team

You will join a diverse, supportive, and highly collaborative network of Airbus industrial architects across Germany, France, and Spain, alongside our external partners. We pride ourselves on a culture of mutual respect, learning, and cross-border cooperation.

Your tasks and responsibilities

● Support the industrial architecture team in various projects, including data analysis, process optimization, and documentation.

● Assist in the development and implementation of architectural concepts and solutions for industrial facilities.

● Conduct research and gather information to support project requirements.

● Prepare presentations and reports for internal stakeholders.

● Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure project success.

Desired skills and qualifications

● Enrolled full-time student in the area of Industrial Economics, Industrial Engineering, Aircraft Design,architecture, mechanical engineering, computer science or an equivalent field of study.

● Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

● Are a natural communicator who enjoys building relationships and thrives in multicultural environments.

● Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Bring an open mindset, a collaborative spirit, and a passion for teamwork.

● Fluency in English (written and spoken), knowledge of German is a plus.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

jobs.occupation: Antitrust Compliance Specialist (m/f/diverse) ContiTech - REF849N (IT-Compliance-Consultant)
jobs.description:
Company Description

Continental is a leading tire manufacturer and industry specialist. Founded in 1871, the company generated sales of €19.7 billion in 2025 and currently employs around 78,000 people in 54 countries and markets.

ContiTech is one of the world’s leading material experts for industry applications. The Continental group sector offers its customers reliable, safe and convenient industry and service solutions using a range of materials for off-highway applications, on rails and roads, in the air, under and above the ground, in industrial environments, for the food sector and the furniture industry. With about 20,000 employees (Status as of March 2026) at more than 60 sites globally, and sales of some 6.0 billion euros (2025), the global industrial partner is active with core branches in Asia, Europe and North and South America.

Job Description

We're looking for a motivated Antitrust Compliance Specialist (m/f/diverse) who is passionate about antitrust compliance and eager to contribute to global initiatives, foster knowledge sharing, and support the ongoing development of our compliance framework.

Your tasks will include the following activities:

- Taking an active role in enhancing and continuously improving ContiTech’s compliance program, particularly with respect to antitrust compliance
- Identifying opportunities to further strengthen the antitrust compliance program through active collaboration and communication with the regions
- Enhancing the concept for association activities and serving as the point of contact for related inquiries from all stakeholders
- Further developing the global antitrust risk assessment process and acting as the point of contact for antitrust-related questions
- Drafting, reviewing, and updating group policies and guidelines related to antitrust compliance
- Managing the rollout of global antitrust initiatives
- Developing content for antitrust training and other preventive measures in close collaboration with relevant departments
- Delivering antitrust training to all ContiTech business areas and central functions
- Designing and implementing additional mitigation measures, such as internal controls and monitoring activities
- Leading lessons-learned projects and driving ongoing improvements to the effectiveness of the antitrust Compliance Management System (CMS)
- Monitoring regulatory developments, best practices, industry trends, and compliance-related topics
- Developing and maintaining a knowledge-sharing concept for antitrust compliance, ensuring that all materials remain relevant and up to date
- Responding to external third-party audits of the ContiTech compliance program

Qualifications

- Qualification as a fully qualified lawyer (First and Second State Examination) is required
- Several years of professional experience in antitrust law and/or compliance, preferably gained in an international company, law firm, or auditing firm
- Additional experience in anti-money laundering (AML) is considered an advantage
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications
- Business-fluent German and English language skills, both written and spoken; additional language skills are a plus
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills combined with a collaborative and team-oriented mindset
- Strong intercultural competence and experience working across functions and international corporate structures
- Independent, structured, and solution-oriented working style
- Willingness to travel internationally

Applications from severely handicapped people are welcome.

Additional Information

The well-being of our employees is important to us. That's why we offer exciting career prospects and support you in achieving a good work-life balance with additional benefits such as:

- Training opportunities
- Mobile and flexible working models
- Sabbaticals

and much more...

jobs.occupation: Quality Conformance Manager (d/f/m) - First Article & Source Inspection (Qualitätskontrolleur/in)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

We are looking for a Quality Conformance Manager (d/f/m) to join our team. In this role, you act as the "quality wall" directly at our supplier locations to secure product conformity and ensure that all components strictly adhere to our design specifications and safety requirements. If you enjoy hands-on quality assurance, working closely with international suppliers and are ready for extensive travel across key production sites, this is the right opportunity for you.

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Note on travel requirements: This role requires extensive international travel for the majority of the year to different supplier locations for short periods (approx. 35 weeks per year, typically in short 1-week trips).

Your benefits

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Act as the accountable quality wall at the supplier side to secure product conformity and ensure safe operation documentation for all cabin parts and cargo work packages released to Final Assembly Lines (FAL), manufacturing plants, and customers
- Plan and execute First Article Inspection (FAI) checks by witnessing supplier FAIs for new cabin and cargo components, ensuring engineering design and specification requirements are correctly understood, verified, and recorded
- Verify supplier FAI readiness upon invitation by checking required FAI documentation, questionnaires, and engineering design review results prior to on-site visits
- Perform Source Inspections (SI) and FAI buy-backs at supplier facilities on special request (e.g., in cases of decreasing quality performance or high customer expectations), occasionally in joint visits with airline customers
- Consult with Engineering departments for technical verification when required, ensuring reproducibility and maintenance of acceptable quality standards for consecutive production parts
- Provide objective evidence, key observations, and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) based on AS/EN/JISQ9102 standard checks to internal interface teams and project departments

Your boarding pass

- University degree in Engineering (Aerospace, Mechanical, or Manufacturing Engineering), Quality Management or a completed qualification as a State-Certified Technician / Master Craftsman (Techniker / Meister) in a relevant technical field
- Initial experience in quality assurance, quality inspection or supplier quality management, ideally within the aerospace or high-tech manufacturing sector
- Solid understanding of quality inspection methods and standard aviation frameworks (familiarity with AS/EN/JISQ9102 FAI standards is a strong asset)
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills to act assertively yet diplomatically as an Airbus quality representative towards external suppliers
- Negotiation level in English; German would be a strong plus
- High flexibility and willingness for extensive international travel (approx. 35 weeks per year, typically in short 1-week trips)
